_comment: Mastery tree families and stable mastery keys (DESIGN §1.7). Hand-maintained; read by tools/build-masteries.js.

families: every listed masteries patch belongs to exactly one family (first..last, listing order). Carry-over between patches maps points by key and only within a family; a family change resets the page. rankTotals = ranks per tree (offense/defense/utility, or ferocity/cunning/resolve); the build checks every dataset of the family against them (M1/M2). legacy = old dataset ids that decode into the family (data/patches/aliases.json codec).

key = slug of the mastery name (lowercase, accents and apostrophes dropped, other runs of non-alphanumerics -> '-'), after the export fixes of data/patches/masteries-overrides.json. aliases[] override that for one cell (DDragon id) over a patch range; the build fails when an alias matches nothing in a patch of its range (stale alias).
Keystone masteries carry the key as both `id` and `key`.

families.note: Season 1 tree (2010 client look). Demolisher exists until V1.0.0.61 (removed with Promote in V1.0.0.63).
Season 3 tree; plain codes (index.html#<code>, no '<id>|') decode with the s3-pbe codec.
Preseason 4 tree up to and including the V5.10 utility overhaul.
Ferocity / Cunning / Resolve, Preseason 6 layout (5-rank icons on the row edges).
Preseason 7 revision (three options on every 1-rank row, centred 5-rank pair).

aliases.name: Runic Shield
aliases.reason: DDragon 3.14 export name; the client, the wiki and the patch notes call it Runic Blessing (DDragon fixed it in 3.15). The name itself is fixed by export-fix mo-001.

aliases.name: Veteran Scars
aliases.reason: DDragon 3.14 export name for Veteran's Scars (fixed in 3.15). The name itself is fixed by export-fix mo-002.

aliases.name: Tenacious
aliases.reason: V3.14 client bug (D4): the tier-5 4-rank armor / magic resist aura is named Tenacious; the key follows the effect, which is Legendary Guardian from V3.15 on (same cell).

aliases.name: Legendary Guardian
aliases.reason: V3.14 client bug (D4): the tier-6 15% crowd-control reduction capstone is named Legendary Guardian; the key follows the effect, which is Tenacious from V3.15 on (same cell).

aliases.name: Stoneborn Pact
aliases.reason: Bond of Stone was reworked and renamed Stoneborn Pact in V7.5 in the same cell (6263, Resolve keystone); points carry over.

notes: Double-Edged Sword keeps its key (the slug of its name) through the DDragon id change 6121 -> 6142 in V6.22; Fresh Blood takes 6121. No alias is needed because keys come from names, not cells.

The S2 V1.0.0.129 Perseverance (Utility, 3/6/9% health and mana regen) has its own key `perseverance`, distinct from `strength-of-spirit`, which takes its cell in V1.0.0.131; points on it do not carry over.
V5.10 swaps the cells of Meditation and Expanded Mind (4313 <-> 4343); keys follow the names, so their points move with them.
